    SELECT TOP 1 hadm_id, admittime
    FROM admissions
    WHERE subject_id = 10027602
    ORDER BY admittime DESC
),
FirstWeight AS (
    SELECT TOP 1 valuenum
    FROM chartevents
    JOIN d_items ON chartevents.itemid = d_items.itemid
    JOIN admissions ON chartevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id
    WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10027602 AND d_items.label LIKE '%weight%'
    ORDER BY charttime ASC
),
SecondWeight AS (
    SELECT TOP 1 valuenum
    FROM chartevents
    JOIN d_items ON chartevents.itemid = d_items.itemid
    JOIN admissions ON chartevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id
    WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10027602 AND d_items.label LIKE '%weight%' AND charttime > (SELECT admittime FROM LastAdmission)
    ORDER BY charttime ASC
)
SELECT SecondWeight.valuenum - FirstWeight.valuenum AS WeightChange
